LanguageData.Oxygendsl_SettingsIntro: Edit mood rules in the current game. Applied changes take effect without restarting; unapplied text stays in the draft.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_NoGame: Load a save to open the script window.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_GameChanged: The current save has changed. Close this window and open it in the new save.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_KeepActive: Changes were not applied. The last valid script remains active. Fix the error below.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_EvaluationFailed: The operation did not finish. Check the error below.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_Cleaned: Rules disabled and this script's effects cleared.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_PositiveInterval: The interval must be a positive integer.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_DraftRestored: Draft restored to the active script.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_TimingHint: Evaluate while paused; time and cooldowns do not advance.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_FileHint: Enter the full path to a UTF-8 script file. A valid script is applied after reading; errors leave the last valid rules active.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_FileRequired: Enter a script file path first.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_ModRulesReloaded: Mod rules reloaded. Native content changes require restarting.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_ModRulesFailed: Some Mod rules were not changed. Check content inspection.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_ProviderUpdated: Provider rules updated. Native definitions and granted traits were not removed.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_SettingsNeedGame: Load a save to change these save-scoped settings.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_EditModConfirm: Open the local Oxygen editor for {0}? Saved file changes affect this installed Mod. Applying runtime rules affects the current save; native content changes need a restart. Keep a backup before making changes. Closing the browser or returning to the main menu leaves the editor running. Use Exit editor in IrisMenus to stop it.
LanguageData.Oxygendsl_ExitEditorConfirm: Stop the local Oxygen editor? All editor tabs will disconnect. Unsaved browser edits will not be saved.
